description_en: Retrieves a list of data development nodes with paging, and supports filtered query by specified conditions
description_zh: 分页获取数据开发节点列表，也可以通过筛选条件对列表进行筛选查询
name: ListNodes

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the workspace configuration page to obtain the workspace ID
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The scene in which the node resides. Leave this parameter empty if not specified. This parameter corresponds to the partition of the left-side navigation pane in DataStudio. Valid values:

DataworksProject: project folder.

DataworksManualWorkflow: manual workflow.

DataworksManualTask: manual node
parameters.help_zh:
筛选条件：节点所在场景，如未指定则不填写，在数据开发中对应左侧目录树的分区可选值： 

DataworksProject 项目目录

DataworksManualWorkflow 手动工作流 

DataworksManualTask 手动任务
parameters.name: scene

parameters.help_en: Leave this parameter empty if not specified. The filter condition: within the specified container. Specify the container ID. This parameter is not related to the resource group (ResourceGroupId)
parameters.help_zh:
如未指定则不填写，筛选条件：在指定容器内。填写容器ID，与资源组（ResourceGroupId）无关。

<notice>该字段在SDK8.0.0版本之前为Long类型，SDK8.0.0版本及之后为String类型。该变更不影响SDK正常使用，参数仍会按SDK中定义的类型返回。只有在跨8.0.0版本的SDK升级时，类型变更可能会导致项目编译不通过，需要用户手动修正数据类型。></notice>
parameters.name: container_id

parameters.help_en:
Filter condition: scheduling type. Valid values:

Normal: The node is executed normally.

Pause: The node status is set to paused, and downstream nodes that depend on the current node are blocked from execution.

Skip: The node status is set to dry run. The system directly returns a success result (with an execution duration of 0 seconds), does not block downstream node execution, and does not consume resources
parameters.help_zh:
筛选条件：调度类型可选值： 

Normal：正常执行任务。

Pause：节点状态被置为暂停，并且会阻塞依赖当前节点的下游节点执行。
 
Skip：节点状态被置为空跑，系统会直接返回成功（执行时长为0秒），不会阻塞下游节点执行，也不会占用资源
parameters.name: recurrence

parameters.help_en:
The rerun property. If not specified, this parameter is left empty. Valid values:

Allowed: The node can be rerun regardless of whether it runs successfully or fails.

FailureAllowed: The node can be rerun only after a failed run, not after a successful run.

Denied: The node cannot be rerun regardless of whether it runs successfully or fails
parameters.help_zh:
重跑属性，如不指定则不填写。取值如下： 

Allowed：运行成功或失败后皆可重跑。
 
FailureAllowed：运行成功后不可重跑，运行失败后可以重跑。
 
Denied：运行成功或失败皆不可重跑
parameters.name: rerun_mode

parameters.help_en: The node name. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 节点名称，支持模糊查询
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_zh: 请求的数据页数，用于翻页
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数，默认为10条，最大100条
parameters.name: page_size
